title: Characterization of a nonfalsified term
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates, and assign each coordinate one of the restrictions free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. The indicator that $T$ is not falsified by this assignment equals true exactly when every literal in $T$ is not falsified by it.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a DNF term on $n$ coordinates
Each coordinate has a restriction chosen from free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$
